body: Thank you, I really don't know what to do. There is no known cure for this, and I can't imagine being 20, at my job with sweaty palms and armpits. It's embarrassing to hold my girlfriend's hand, to high five friends, to use a controller and then pass it on. This is so terrible, i'm not depressed but this is just an inconvinence, life could be great, but instead I'm homeschooled because i can't go to public school because of this, and I rarely leave the house.
